title: HELIX Bridge (Reverse): HELIX Course → Banner SaaS (Ethos)
write_model: POST/PUT /api/courses with GUID-resolved references (subject, owning units, levels). Search by subject+number before create to avoid duplicates.

attribute_mappings.transformation: subject is a GUID reference to subjects; number is the catalog number.
Map fixed or variable credit to the credits[] structure.
attribute_mappings.notes: Ethos courses model credits as an array supporting variable ranges.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map owning department/college to institution-units GUID.

constraints: courses supports create/update on many tenants but requires GUID resolution for subject, institution-units, course-levels, and academic-levels.
Catalog structure is often curriculum-governed; coordinate writes with the registrar's catalog process.
